name: Greek Lemon-Oregano Chicken & Potatoes
subtitle: With village salad (horiatiki) and tzatziki
equipment: 2 sheet pans, air fryer, thermometer, box grater, jar
before: **2¼ lb chicken breast** thawed in the fridge.
Most prep happens while the potatoes roast.
notes: Zest goes on before roasting and juice after, because juice blocks browning. Lunch salads stay undressed.

steps.title: Heat the oven
steps.body: Racks lower-middle and upper-middle. An **empty sheet pan** on the lower rack. Heat to **425°F**.

steps.title: Lemons
steps.body: Zest **1 lemon** into a large bowl (for the chicken). Juice **both lemons** into a cup (~4–5 Tbsp): **2 Tbsp** chicken, **1 Tbsp** tzatziki, **1 Tbsp** potatoes.

steps.title: Potatoes in
steps.body: Cut **2½ lb yellow potatoes** into ¾-inch cubes and pat dry. Toss with **1½ Tbsp olive oil + 1 tsp oregano + 1 tsp salt + ½ tsp pepper**. Spread on the hot pan, cut sides down, lower rack.

steps.title: Chicken in, while the potatoes roast
steps.body: Cut **2¼ lb chicken** into 1½-inch chunks. Toss in the zest bowl with **1 Tbsp olive oil + 4 cloves garlic, grated + 2 tsp oregano + 1¼ tsp salt + ½ tsp pepper**. Spread on the second pan, spaced apart. Upper rack, **15–18 min**.

steps.title: Flip potatoes, start chickpeas
steps.body: Flip the potatoes; **15–20 min more**. Drain, rinse and dry **1 can chickpeas**, toss with **1 tsp olive oil + ½ tsp smoked paprika + ¼ tsp salt**, and air-fry at **390°F for 12–15 min**, shaking twice.

steps.title: Tzatziki
steps.body: Grate **½ English cucumber** and squeeze it hard in a towel. Mix with **1½ cups Greek yogurt + 2 cloves garlic, grated + 1 Tbsp lemon juice + 1 tsp dill + 1 tsp olive oil + ½ tsp salt**. Refrigerate.

steps.title: Pull the chicken
steps.body: Start checking at 13 min; pull at **160°F**. Pour **2 Tbsp lemon juice** over it on the pan, toss and rest.

steps.title: Salad
steps.body: Shake in a jar: **2 Tbsp olive oil + 2 Tbsp red wine vinegar + 1 tsp oregano + ¼ tsp salt**. Cut **2 cucumbers, 9 oz tomatoes, ½ red onion, 1 green pepper, 6 oz feta**; add **⅓ cup kalamatas**. Dress ~⅓ with **2 Tbsp** dressing; the rest goes undressed into 4 lunch containers with the remaining dressing on the side.

steps.title: Pull the potatoes
steps.body: When deeply golden, toss on the pan with **1 Tbsp lemon juice** and salt to taste.

after: Pack 4 lunches: chicken, potatoes and chickpeas, plus undressed salad, a dressing cup and ~⅓ cup tzatziki each. Good through Monday.

macros.portion: About 4½ oz cooked chicken, 1 cup roasted potatoes, ¼ cup chickpeas, ⅓ cup tzatziki and 1½ cups village salad.
macros.note: Rough estimate from standard nutrition values for the listed amounts, not a lab number. Includes salad, tzatziki and chickpeas; about a third of the calories come from olive oil and feta.
